content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the trade list's Scroll container (rowgroup) moves between scroll_y 225 and scroll_y 0 in repeated pairs, with the pointer resting at the same spot (x 750, y 425) between reversals and no click or typing, which suggests the visible rows do not show their full content in the viewport and the user is scrolling back and forth to re-check them.", "fix": "Fix: On the trade list screen, enlarge the Scroll container (the rowgroup element) so its full 225 px of rows fits in the viewport without scrolling, or make the column header row sticky inside that container so a user who scrolls down keeps the column labels in view.", "cited_event_ids": ["268", "271:322", "274", "279", "281:333", "285", "291", "296", "302"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Why the user scrolled back and forth; the events show direction and position only, not intent.", "The row content, column layout and viewport height of the trade list, so the proposed fix assumes the 225 px extent is hidden rows.", "Whether the pattern repeats across other sessions beyond the cited windows.", "Whether the scroll reversals lead to any later action; the insight reports no abandonment."]}
